set.body:
Add a crossProject surface-view module depending only on surface and graphics. Define smart-constructed SurfaceId, SurfaceLayerId, opacity/range/camera scalars, a closed SurfaceLayer ADT for scalar, labels, mask, and packed RGBA data, and immutable SurfaceViewerModel and SurfaceViewerState values. Use typed viewpoints for lateral/medial by cortical hemisphere plus anterior/posterior/dorsal/ventral, explicit bilateral arrangements, camera projection, lighting, clipping, selected vertex, and timepoint. Add a total action reducer.

Compile model plus state into a platform-free SurfaceRenderPlan containing stable mesh/layer resource keys, packed positions/normals/indices or validated views, layer/style packets, camera matrices, draw passes, 2D graphics Scene chrome, readouts, and SurfaceProfile counters. No DOM, Three.js, JavaFX, LWJGL, mutable toolkit object, or backend handle may enter shared APIs.

Acceptance: invalid layer/domain combinations, duplicate ids, invalid cameras, incompatible timepoints, and unsupported operations are typed errors; surfaceToWorld is applied before view/projection; camera-only recompilation preserves all resource keys; packed hot paths use primitive arrays and while loops; shared JVM and Scala.js suites cover construction, reducer laws, layer order, bilateral layout, readouts, cache invalidation, and deterministic receipts.
set.title: Surface view core: typed scene model, state reducer, render plan, and receipts
